name: definitely-wizards
description: Definitely Wizards system for Foundry VTT v14

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:foundry
scripts.pack:props: fvtt package pack -n definitely-wizards-props --type System --in packs/_source/definitely-wizards-props --out packs
scripts.pack:spells: fvtt package pack -n definitely-wizards-spells --type System --in packs/_source/definitely-wizards-spells --out packs
scripts.build:packs: npm run build:macros && npm run pack:props && npm run pack:spells
scripts.unpack:props: fvtt package unpack -n definitely-wizards-props --type System --in packs --out packs/_source/definitely-wizards-props
scripts.unpack:spells: fvtt package unpack -n definitely-wizards-spells --type System --in packs --out packs/_source/definitely-wizards-spells
